{{Youmay|the [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] Viamarr Blackroot|the beverage [[Blackroot/Legends|blackroot]]}}
'''Viamarr Blackroot''' was a type of subterranean [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Viamarr 4]]. Its offshoots and tubers sometimes grew to the diameter of a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]]. It was well liked for its meaty texture and nutrient balance.<ref name="ws">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
